name: kick
description: Deep sine pitch drop with a brief filtered noise beater.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Fixed oscillator tuning independent of note pitch; noise has no pitch.
guidance.notes: Use short note gates for tighter hits; extend the gate and release for a longer decay. Each hit is independently polyphonic; open and closed hats do not choke one another.

name: mellow_piano
description: Soft triangle body with gently decaying harmonic FM; a synthesized piano interpretation.

guidance.notes: The body decays while held; release controls the ending after note-off.

name: bright_piano
description: Brisk triangle body and stronger third-harmonic FM attack; a synthesized bright piano interpretation.

guidance.notes: The body decays while held; release controls the ending after note-off.

name: electric_piano
description: Rounded sine fundamental with an envelope-shaped FM octave tine; a synthesized electric piano interpretation.

guidance.notes: The body decays while held; release controls the ending after note-off.

name: organ
description: Sustained additive drawbar-like harmonic blend; a synthesized organ interpretation without rotary effects.

guidance.notes: Hold notes for sustain and use release to shape the ending.

name: nylon_guitar
description: Synthesized nylon-string interpretation: rounded sine/triangle body with a brief harmonic FM pluck.

guidance.notes: Use 0.08–1.5 s note gates; zero sustain produces a natural decay even for held notes. Muted guitar chiefly sounds within the first 0.16 s.

name: steel_guitar
description: Synthesized steel-string interpretation: brighter saw body and a longer, stronger harmonic FM transient.

guidance.notes: Use 0.08–1.5 s note gates; zero sustain produces a natural decay even for held notes. Muted guitar chiefly sounds within the first 0.16 s.

name: muted_guitar
description: Synthesized muted-string interpretation: short damped sine/triangle pluck with a rapidly fading FM transient.

guidance.notes: Use 0.08–1.5 s note gates; zero sustain produces a natural decay even for held notes. Muted guitar chiefly sounds within the first 0.16 s.

name: finger_bass
description: Rounded finger-style bass interpretation with triangle and sine body, a soft attack, and a short plucked decay.

guidance.notes: Use the low register for bass lines; leave room between note-offs and the next note when a clean release is wanted.

name: pick_bass
description: Picked electric-bass interpretation with a bright square-wave edge, sine body, fast attack, and a firmer plucked decay.

guidance.notes: Use the low register for bass lines; leave room between note-offs and the next note when a clean release is wanted.

name: sub_bass
description: Deep sustained sine bass with a trace of triangle harmonics and a rounded attack; intended for low registers.

guidance.notes: Use the low register for bass lines; leave room between note-offs and the next note when a clean release is wanted.

name: synth_bass
description: Sustained synth bass with two slightly detuned saw oscillators and a sine sub-octave, filtered for a dense low end.

guidance.notes: Use the low register for bass lines; leave room between note-offs and the next note when a clean release is wanted.

name: strings
description: Gently detuned saw pair and octave triangle with a bowed-style onset; a synthesized string ensemble interpretation.

guidance.notes: Hold notes for sustain and use release to shape the ending.

name: flute
description: Sine-led sustained tone with a faint triangle edge and modest fixed-depth vibrato; a synthesized flute interpretation.

guidance.notes: Hold notes for sustain and use release to shape the ending.

name: bell
description: Decaying inharmonic FM strike with a faint octave component; a synthesized bell interpretation.

guidance.notes: The body decays while held; release controls the ending after note-off.

name: warm_pad
description: Slowly swelling detuned triangle pair with a sine sub-octave and dark low-pass tone.

guidance.notes: Allow at least 1.5 seconds for the slow attack to develop; longer held notes create a sustained pad.

name: synth_lead
description: Responsive saw, square and sine blend with subtle vibrato and a bright sustained tone.

guidance.notes: Hold notes for sustain and use release to shape the ending.
